name: Cleartext HTTP Communication
description: Detects external http:// endpoints that can transmit application data without transport encryption.
messageTemplate: External network communication uses HTTP instead of HTTPS.
remediation: Use HTTPS for remote endpoints and validate the server certificate. Keep cleartext localhost/emulator endpoints limited to development environments.

name: Cleartext WebSocket Communication
description: Detects external ws:// WebSocket endpoints that do not use TLS.
messageTemplate: External WebSocket communication uses ws:// instead of wss://.
remediation: Use wss:// for remote WebSocket communication and validate the server certificate.

name: TLS Certificate Validation Bypass
description: Detects explicit certificate-validation bypasses, including badCertificateCallback callbacks that unconditionally return true and validateCertificate set to false.
messageTemplate: TLS certificate validation is explicitly bypassed.
remediation: Keep platform certificate validation enabled. If certificate pinning or custom trust logic is required, validate the expected certificate, public key, or host instead of accepting all invalid certificates.

name: Insecure gRPC Channel
description: Detects ChannelCredentials.insecure() which creates a gRPC channel without TLS.
messageTemplate: gRPC transport security is disabled by ChannelCredentials.insecure().
remediation: Use ChannelCredentials.secure() and configure trusted certificates for production gRPC connections.

name: HTTPS to HTTP Downgrade Fallback
description: Detects error-handling logic that tries HTTPS and falls back to an external HTTP endpoint when the secure connection fails.
messageTemplate: Secure HTTPS communication falls back to cleartext HTTP after a failure.
remediation: Fail closed when HTTPS fails or retry a trusted HTTPS endpoint. Do not downgrade production communication to HTTP.

name: Weak TLS Protocol Configuration
description: Detects explicit minimum TLS protocol configuration that permits TLS 1.0 or TLS 1.1.
messageTemplate: The network configuration permits an outdated TLS protocol.
remediation: Require TLS 1.2 or newer and rely on current platform defaults where possible.

name: WebView Mixed Content Enabled
description: Detects MixedContentMode.alwaysAllow which permits HTTP resources to be loaded inside HTTPS WebView content.
messageTemplate: WebView mixed content is explicitly allowed.
remediation: Disallow mixed content and load WebView resources over HTTPS.
